title: 835. New 21 Game

examples.explanation: Every first draw stops the game within the limit.
Six of ten faces stay within 6.

hints: This is a portable adaptation: return the probability as a finite decimal string; grading allows 1e-5 absolute error.
Let dp[i] be the chance of ever holding exactly i points; then dp[i] is the average of the previous maxPts values that are still below k.
Maintain a sliding window sum so each dp[i] is O(1), and add up dp[k] through dp[n] for the answer.
